title: Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning, Acting, and Planning in Language Models
layout_note: Six numbered operation panels in one row (1) Selection, 2) Expansion, 3) Evaluation, 4) Simulation, 5) Backpropagation, 6) Reflection), each showing the same small search tree at a different moment; no panel borders.
grouping: Panels are separated only by whitespace and numbered titles above each; meaning is grouped by colour: blue ellipses for the input root, red/pink squares for the active path, grey squares for unvisited siblings, lavender rounded boxes for the LM, pale yellow boxes for the value or reflection, green ellipses for the output.
shapes_depth: Flat filled shapes with no outlines: ellipses for input/output, small squares labelled S1, S2, S3 for states, rounded rectangles for the LM; arrows are thin coloured lines, with darker red arrows pointing back up the tree in the backpropagation panel.
proposed_highlight: The search path being operated on is the only saturated colour: the selected node is solid dark red, nodes on the current path are pink and their arrows red, while alternatives stay grey.
lesson: Show a search algorithm as a filmstrip of the same tree, one panel per operation, recolouring only the nodes the current operation touches.
notes: venue from the first page (Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 235, 2024); year = venue year. Figure 1 is a smaller system-loop overview (environment globe, LLM agent robot, memory, tree search); Figure 2 was chosen because it draws the six operations of the method itself.

taxonomy.task: LM agent reasoning, acting and planning via Monte Carlo tree search

insights.structure: Six borderless panels in a single row, each a numbered MCTS operation drawn on the same small tree of an Input ellipse and S1/S2/S3 squares, with the Evaluation and Reflection panels replacing the tree by a vertical LM -> Value / LM -> Reflection chain.
insights.data: States are small labelled squares (S1, S2, S3), the root and terminal are blue Input and green Output ellipses, the language model is a lavender 'LM' box and its products are pale yellow 'Value' and 'Reflection' boxes.
insights.emphasis: Colour carries the operation: the selected node is solid red, the active branch is pink with red arrows, unexplored siblings are grey, and backpropagation adds thicker red upward arrows beside the downward ones.
insights.flow: Read panels left to right by their 1) to 6) titles; within each panel arrows run top to bottom down the tree, except Backpropagation where paired arrows point back up to the root.
insights.avoid: The 'Value' and 'Reflection' boxes use very small type relative to the S-node labels, and the panels have no separators so 'S' in panel 6 floats without context.

arrangement.units: six unbordered columns, one per search operation, each titled with a number and name and holding a small tree or LM chain
arrangement.inputs_as: a blue 'Input' ellipse as the tree root at the top of each panel
arrangement.shared: the LM is redrawn as the same lavender box in the Evaluation and Reflection panels

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
